name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit_ReOpen
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, which is a JMA-smoothed FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) with digit rounding. It opens initial positions on trend direction changes and then pyramids (adds) into existing positions at fixed price step intervals (ReOpen mechanism), up to a configurable maximum number of add-on trades per position, with configurable SL/TP on each entry.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit指标（JMA平滑的FATL快速自适应趋势线+数字舍入）进行交易。在趋势方向变化时开仓，随后以固定价格间距对已有仓位进行加码（ReOpen机制），最多可加码至指定次数，每笔交易均设有止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：基于ColorJFatl_Digit指标的趋势跟踪策略，该指标将FATL（39期数字滤波器）的输出经JMA平滑后再进行数字舍入，以减少噪声产生更清晰的趋势信号。入场条件：当指标颜色缓冲区值从非2变为2时做多，从非0变为0时做空，即趋势方向发生变化的时刻。加码机制：当已有持仓时，价格朝有利方向移动超过PriceStep（默认300点）间距后触发加码，最多可加码PosTotal次（默认10次），每次加码使用相同的手数逻辑。出场条件：反向信号触发平仓——当指标变为0时平多仓，变为2时平空仓；每笔交易均设有StopLoss和TakeProfit。仓位管理：通过MM参数控制资金比例，支持多种仓位计算模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损比例、固定手数），加码时使用LOT模式计算增量手数。资金管理：加码手数与初始手数相同（非递增或倍增），每次加码独立设置止损止盈，但加码的止损止盈是基于当前加码价格而非原始入场价，这可能导致加码仓位的风险敞口与初始仓位不一致。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a trend-following system based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, which applies JMA smoothing to the FATL (39-period digital filter) output and then rounds to configurable digit precision, reducing noise for cleaner trend signals. Entry conditions: A buy signal fires when the indicator color buffer transitions from a non-2 value to 2 (uptrend start), and a sell signal fires when it transitions from non-0 to 0 (downtrend start), capturing trend direction changes. Pyramiding mechanism: When a position already exists, additional entries (ReOpen) are triggered when price moves favorably by at least PriceStep (default 300 points) from the last entry price, up to PosTotal times (default 10), with each add-on using the same lot sizing logic. Exit conditions: Opposite signals close positions — buy positions close when the indicator turns to 0, sell positions close when it turns to 2; each trade has independent StopLoss and TakeProfit. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter with multiple modes (free margin, balance, loss-based, fixed lot), while pyramiding entries use LOT mode for incremental volume. Money management: Add-on lot sizes equal the initial lot (no progressive increase or doubling), each add-on sets its own SL/TP based on the add-on entry price rather than the original entry, which can lead to inconsistent risk exposure across the position's constituent trades.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易占存款资金的比例

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数确定方式：自由保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing method: free margin/balance/loss ratio/fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏离点数（滑点）

parameters.name: PriceStep
parameters.description: 加码价格网格间距（点数）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 趋势跟踪加码机制合理，仅在价格朝有利方向移动时才加仓，避免逆势加仓的风险
每笔交易均设有独立的止损止盈，风险边界明确，加码手数与初始手数一致而非倍增，避免马丁格尔式风险
使用JMA+FATL双重平滑与数字舍入，信号经过多重过滤噪声较少，适合中长线趋势捕捉
pros_en: The pyramiding mechanism is sound — add-ons only occur when price moves favorably, avoiding the danger of averaging down into losing positions
Each trade has independent SL/TP with clear risk boundaries; add-on lot sizing matches the initial lot rather than doubling, avoiding martingale-style risk escalation
JMA+FATL dual smoothing with digit rounding provides multi-layer noise filtering, producing cleaner signals suitable for medium-to-long-term trend capture
cons: 加码机制可累积最多10次加仓，在强趋势中可能过度集中风险敞口，总持仓量可达初始仓位的11倍
加码时止损止盈基于加码价格设置而非统一管理，加码仓位的止损可能与初始仓位方向不一致导致整体持仓保护不完整
仅支持单品种交易（使用PositionSelect按Symbol选仓），无法多品种并行运行；无新K线检查仅在SignalBar=0时启用
cons_en: Pyramiding up to 10 add-ons can concentrate excessive risk exposure in strong trends, with total position size reaching 11x the initial entry
Add-on SL/TP are set from the add-on price rather than managed holistically, potentially leaving overall position protection inconsistent across constituent trades
Only supports single-symbol trading (uses PositionSelect by Symbol), preventing multi-instrument parallel operation; new bar check only activates when SignalBar=0
improvements: 应实现整体仓位的统一止损管理，而非每笔加码独立设止损，避免部分仓位被单独止损而整体仓位仍暴露风险
应增加总持仓量上限控制和最大回撤限制，防止加码累积过度风险敞口
improvements_en: Implement holistic position-level stop loss management instead of per-entry SL, to avoid partial stops triggering while the overall position remains exposed
Add total position size caps and maximum drawdown limits to prevent excessive risk accumulation from pyramiding

risk_points: 加码机制可累积大量持仓，最多11层仓位叠加风险显著
每笔加码止损独立设置，整体仓位缺乏统一风险保护
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点较大，单笔亏损可能较重
risk_points_en: Pyramiding can accumulate up to 11 layered positions with significant combined risk exposure
Each add-on has independent SL, leaving the overall position without unified risk protection
Default SL of 1000 pips and TP of 2000 pips are large, meaning individual trade losses can be substantial
